info.name: DevSync — Complete Backend API
info.description: Run folders 00–08 in order. Folder 09 requires Cloudinary and a local image selection; run manually. Folder 10 changes then restores the test owner password. Folder 99 deletes the generated project data. Deselect 09 and 99 for a normal automated run that retains your data.

item.name: 00 Setup - RUN FIRST
item.description: Run this whole folder once. Creates NEW disposable users, one project, membership and one assigned task. Tokens and IDs are saved automatically. Rerunning starts a fresh dataset; previous data is not erased.
